d:
A private detective is tasked by a businessman to find his daughter. However, while investigating, he gets involved with his former girlfriend, a policewoman who is chasing an international criminal.
Movie - MR.JOE B CARVALHO (2014)
Director - Samir Tewari
Writers - Mahesh Ramchandani, Arshad Sayyad
Star Cast - Arshad Warsi, Soha Ali Khan, Jaaved Jaaferi, Shakti Kapoor, Vijay Raaz, Manoj Joshi,
Karishma Kotak, Ranjeet, Vrajesh Hirjee, Geeta Basra.
